title: AI spend surges across enterprises as OpenAI and Anthropic dominate budgets while old SaaS providers struggle to survive | TechRadar
summary: AI-native vendors are dominating enterprise software budgets with significant growth, while traditional SaaS tools are losing relevance. OpenAI and Anthropic are major beneficiaries of this shift, with a concentration of spend among a few vendors and higher pricing tied to AI capabilities.
sentiment_reason: The article indicates a positive market impact due to the growth and dominance of AI-native vendors in the enterprise software market, despite the pressure from higher pricing and the decline of traditional SaaS tools.
